response.sql:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS matched_order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT ordertune, matched_order_count,
         AVG(matched_order_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT AVG(matched_order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(matched_order_count - average_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average
WHERE matched_order_count > average_count;

assumptions.assumption: Each joined risk/margin record counts as one matched order; if an order has multiple risk/margin records, it is counted once per matching record.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct orders per order type, so multiple risk/margin records for one order count only once.
alternatives.sql:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS matched_order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT ordertune, matched_order_count,
         AVG(matched_order_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT AVG(matched_order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(matched_order_count - average_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average
WHERE matched_order_count > average_count;
